reference_prompt_text: (populate from whisper after a clean ~60s Musk-only segment is selected from the Kamath interview)

phrases.build_success: The build succeeded. This is, you know, important. Probably.
phrases.build_failed: The build failed. We will iterate. That's how engineering works.
phrases.tests_passed: Tests passed. Hardcore mode is, you know, the optimal mode.
phrases.tests_failed: Tests failed. We need to figure out, fundamentally, what is the issue here.
phrases.lint_error: The linter is complaining. Linters, in general, are pedantic.
phrases.type_error: Type error. We're going to have to, you know, address this. Carefully.
phrases.deploy_success: We shipped it. To Mars. Well, to production. But, you know, eventually Mars.
phrases.deploy_failed: Deploy failed. This is, you know, suboptimal.
phrases.commit_success: You committed. Move fast. But, you know, don't break things. Or do.
phrases.push_rejected: Push rejected. Git is, in many ways, hostile to the user.
phrases.secret_detected: You leaked an API key. To, you know, the entire internet. This is bad. Rotate it immediately.
phrases.agent_done: The AI finished. We're going to have to, you know, audit what it did. Carefully.
phrases.agent_stuck: The AI got stuck. AGI, you know, is harder than people think.
